This is the updated 1.1 version of the GoC goal scores, after updates made from the Expert Working Group 3.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(plotly)
library(zoo)

final_output_dir <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/final_cs_scores/v1.1"
final_output_components_dir <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/final_cs_scores/v1.1/subgoals"

# Round scores to nearest whole number for final outputs
round_cs <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(current_status = round(current_status))
}
```


## TR 

Overall

```{r}
tr_cs <- read_csv(here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/tr/v2025/output/tr_current_status_final_092926.csv")
) %>% 
  rename(current_status = tr_current_status) %>% 
  mutate(goal = "tourism_recreation") %>% 
  round_cs()

write_csv(tr_cs, here::here(final_output_dir, "TR_Scores_1.1_df_Oct2026.csv"))
```

## LE

```{r}
le_cs <- read_csv(here::here(
    "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/le",
    "final_le_current_status_2019ref_informality.csv"
  )) %>% 
  select(rgn_id, year = ano_censal, current_status = final_le_current_status_rgn) %>% 
  mutate(goal = "livelihoods_economies")


le_cs_gf <- le_cs %>% 
  complete(rgn_id, year = full_seq(2003:2025, 1)) %>%  # expand to every year 2003-2025
  arrange(rgn_id, year) %>% 
  group_by(rgn_id) %>% 
  mutate(current_status = na.approx(current_status, x = year, na.rm = FALSE, rule = 2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(goal = "livelihoods_economies") %>% 
  round_cs()

write_csv(le_cs_gf, here::here(final_output_dir, "LE_Scores_1.1_df_Oct2026.csv"))
```

### LIV

```{r}
liv_cs <- read_csv(here::here(
    "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/le/liv",
    "liv_current_status_2019ref_informality.csv"
  )) %>% 
  select(rgn_id, year = ano_censal, current_status = liv_current_status) %>% 
  mutate(
    current_status = ifelse(rgn_id == "Region_2", NA_real_, current_status),
    goal = "le_livelihoods"
  )

liv_cs_gf <- liv_cs %>% 
  complete(rgn_id, year = full_seq(2003:2025, 1)) %>% 
  arrange(rgn_id, year) %>% 
  group_by(rgn_id) %>% 
  mutate(current_status = zoo::na.approx(current_status, x = year, na.rm = FALSE, rule = 2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(goal = "le_livelihoods") %>% 
  round_cs()

write_csv(liv_cs_gf, here::here(final_output_components_dir, "LE_LIV_Scores_1.1_df_Oct2026.csv"))
```
